secrets.name: ZERNIO_API_KEY
secrets.description: Zernio API key (Instagram analytics provider) — from your Zernio account dashboard

secrets.name: ZERNIO_ACCOUNT_ID
secrets.description: Zernio account ID for the Instagram account being tracked — from your Zernio account dashboard

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic API key (Claude) used for idea generation — from console.anthropic.com

secrets.name: SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Supabase project JWT secret (Project Settings → API) — used by the backend to verify auth tokens

secrets.name: REACT_APP_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (https://xxxxx.supabase.co) — used by the frontend for auth

secrets.name: REACT_APP_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon public key (Project Settings → API) — used by the frontend for auth
